title: Chapter 290: Sky Overlord Devourer

Chapter 290: Sky Overlord Devourer

Wu Qing selected the Zerg larvae in the mother nest next to him and found that he could choose to hatch scorpions and mammoths. He looked at the resources required for hatching and found a long list of numbers as he expected.

"Sure enough, super strong abilities must be supported by sufficient strength. The initial levels of these four ultimate arms are limited!"

"With the current strength of the Zerg, these ultimate arms can only be hatched in small quantities, but it is enough for the time being!"

Wu Qing saw that the initial strength star level of the Zerg scorpion and mammoth was six stars. The consumption of hatching one was enough to hatch a group of five-star Zerg queens.

With such huge resource consumption, it is not surprising that they are powerful.

Wu Qing did not hatch the Zerg scorpion and mammoth. In the Zerg territory, the Zerg's ultimate arms could not play a role for the time being.

...

Wu Qing came to the underground space of the Zerg territory base camp, chose an open area, and built a pupa passage.

He then controlled the Zerg worker bees in the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city and the second Zerg sub-base at the junction of the demon territory to build pupa channels respectively.

Through the pupa channel, the three Zerg bases were truly connected in space.

Wu Qing's body could reach the first or second Zerg base instantly if he wanted to.

A large number of Zerg troops could also be teleported through the pupa channel.

The pupa channel can also upgrade the star level of the building. The higher the star level, the stronger its teleportation ability.

Wu Qing built the Zerg space teleportation channel and consciously came to the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city.

He selected 20 Zerg larvae and consumed a lot of resources to hatch ten Zerg scorpions and ten Zerg mammoths respectively.

The Zerg scorpion with an initial strength of six stars looks a bit like an ordinary scorpion, but without an aggressive scorpion tail.

Their size is comparable to that of a five-star Zerg Hydralisk, and they are not very noticeable in the Zerg army.

Zerg scorpions, which look ordinary, have terrible abilities, and their strength is also the first batch of Zerg to reach six stars.

Zerg scorpions are spellcasting soldiers, and their own defense and vitality are not outstanding, so they need the protection of other soldiers.

Wu Qing thought about it and upgraded some five-star transport hosts. A transport host flew over, loaded ten Zerg scorpions and a group of Zerg puppies, and flew to the battlefield where the Tianwai human race Jiujiuliu City was fighting fiercely.

The ten six-star Zerg mammoths, with a huge body of more than ten meters, looked like a hill full of sharp blades, which was daunting.

Especially the two main battle giant swords, which shook slightly with the movements of the Zerg mammoths, and an indescribable terrible murderous aura came out of their bodies.

The Zerg mammoths were huge in size, and they were the largest combat soldiers Wu Qing had ever seen in this world, even larger than the mountain giants he had seen before.

Wu Qing transferred five five-star transport hosts, each carrying two six-star Zerg Mammoths, which was not difficult.

The loading space of the transport host can be changed. A five-star transport host can easily hold two huge six-star Zerg Mammoths.

Five five-star transport hosts loaded with Zerg Mammoths also flew quickly to the battlefield where the fierce battle was going on.

Wu Qing's consciousness shifted to a group of Zerg flying dragons flying towards the battlefield. These Zerg flying dragons were reinforcements to supplement the losses of the main combat arms in the front battlefield.

The fierce battle between the Zerg and the aliens consumed a lot of troops. Various reinforcements of the alien army continued, and even the flying arms were constantly coming to help. The constant fighting caused the Zerg flying dragons to lose a lot of troops.

With the arrival of Wu Qing's consciousness, the group of Zerg flying dragons immediately flew higher and flew out of sight on the ground.

Wu Qing selected a one-star Zerg flying dragon and found that it had the option of evolving into an air guard and a devourer.

Because the Zerg Sky Guards and Zerg Devourers evolved from Zerg Dragons, their initial strength was limited to a minimum of five stars, not six stars like the Zerg Scorpions and Zerg Mammoths.

The resources consumed were much more than other five-star arms, but it was still acceptable.

"With five-star strength, such consumption, the system setting is still very reasonable. If the number of these two arms is too small, they will not be able to play a role."

"Only when they form a certain scale can they exert their true power."

Wu Qing immediately selected two thousand Zerg Dragons and evolved them into one thousand five-star Sky Guards and one thousand five-star Devourers respectively.

After just a moment of waiting, the five-star Zerg Sky Guards and Devourers broke out of the cocoon. Both of them were nearly ten-meter-long aerial giants, much larger than the five-star Zerg Dragons.

From the size, you can see the difference in strength between them and the Zerg Dragons.

The appearance of the Zerg Sky Guards is a bit similar to that of butterflies, but the whole body is covered with carapace segments, with the unique and ferocious characteristics of the Zerg.

The Zerg Devourer looked like a large beetle with tentacles, with a round body, flying in the air. From a distance, it looked a bit like a Zerg Host.

The evolved five-star Zerg Sky Guard and the five-star Zerg Devourer, along with the Zerg Dragons guarding them, continued to fly towards the battlefield.

Among them, the Zerg Sky Guards have the slowest flying speed, but with their five-star strength, they can easily keep up with the one-star Zerg Dragons in terms of speed.

This Zerg air support force was about to arrive near the battlefield. It took them a little time to evolve and upgrade, but it was still much faster than the Zerg Scorpions and Zerg Mammoths that took the transport host from the first Zerg sub-base to the battlefield.

When they arrived at the battlefield, the huge size of the five-star Zerg Sky Guards and the five-star Zerg Devourers attracted the attention of all parties.

"Look! There are new soldiers among the Zerg reinforcements! Two flying soldiers!"

"With this body type, they are strong Zerg soldiers!"

"The number of the two new Zerg soldiers is small, let's see what surprises they can bring!"

"The Zerg fought very hard in this battle. Even the main combat soldiers with very few losses suffered a large number of casualties. They barely supported it with the continuous reinforcements from the rear!"

"The aliens are increasing their troops too fast! The Zerg melee soldiers are not small, but their strength is still far behind, and the reinforcement speed of the main combat soldiers can't keep up!"

"If they keep fighting like this, the situation of the Zerg will be very bad!"

"The Zerg has now sent out new powerful soldiers. Let's see if they can turn the tide of the battle!"

"..."

The spectators from all forces in the local camp are looking forward to the battlefield performance of the two new Zerg soldiers.

Wu Qing returned to the battlefield, received the information reported by the Queen, and observed the battlefield situation through the Zerg host. He found that the Zerg army was fighting very hard with the support of the reinforcements sent by the aliens at all costs.

Except for the Zerg Destroyers and Zerg Stealth Spiders, the casualties of other arms were very heavy.

The Queen has reinforced several batches of Zerg main combat arms, and now the strength of the Zerg main combat arms is still less than half of its heyday.

Zerg Dragons, Zerg Cockroaches, Zerg Hydralisks, and Type II Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions have all suffered a lot of casualties, and many Zerg Destroyers have been beaten to lose their combat effectiveness.

The number of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes has decreased a lot. Without Wu Qing's consent, the Queen cannot upgrade them to five-star levels unless it is an emergency, so the effect of their participation in the war is not obvious.

The state of the three thousand Zerg Queens is also not good. Obviously, they have been using various abilities to assist in combat.

Not to mention the Zerg Puppies and Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, their casualties are countless. It is only with their fearless sacrifice that they can barely stop the attack of the alien human army.

The only Zerg arm that has not been lost is the Zerg Stealth Spiders that have been lurking underground to attack. They have played a huge role in ground combat.

The five-star Zerg Devourers that came with the reinforcement of the Zerg Dragons had an extremely fast flying speed. Wu Qing found that the Zerg Dragons in front were fighting fiercely in the air battle, so he immediately ordered them to fly at full speed to support them.

One thousand five-star Zerg Devourers flew at full speed, instantly separated from the team, and flew to the air battle battlefield at a very fast speed.

"Puff...Puff...!"

From a distance, the five-star Zerg Devourers began to spray mucus to attack the flying soldiers of the alien race.

The huge body of the Zerg Devourers was enough to support them to spray a large amount of terrible mucus, which was scattered and splashed on a large number of alien flying soldiers in the distance.

Those one-star alien flying soldiers could not withstand the super-strong corrosive attack of the terrible mucus at all. The moment they were touched by the mucus, a large number of them died and disappeared in light.

The mucus left on the bodies of the dead alien flying soldiers will fall down, or fall on other flying soldiers below, or fall on other soldiers on the ground below, or may fall directly to the ground.

As long as the soldiers of the alien army with weak strength are stained with the mucus sprayed by the five-star Zerg Devourer, they will definitely be killed or injured.

If the attack of the Zerg Devourer is just like this, it cannot be called the ultimate Zerg soldier.

What's more terrifying is that the mucus sprayed by the Zerg Devourer will splash a large number of invisible special spores when it falls on the enemy.

These special spores that splash around will immediately affect the attacks of other enemies as long as they come into contact with other enemies, seriously affecting the enemy's attack speed.

These special spores will also quickly weaken the enemy's defense, making the enemy's defense extremely fragile.

The result of a round of attack by a thousand five-star Zerg Devourers is to instantly kill a large number of alien flying soldiers, making more alien flying soldiers almost lose their offensive capabilities and can only passively take the beating.

Under the attack of the Zerg dragon group, the alien flying soldiers, which originally had very strong defenses, now fell down like ordinary animals, and large patches of light disappeared.
